statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The PREAUTH response is always untagged and is one of three possible greetings at connection startup. It indicates that the connection has already been authenticated by external means; thus, no LOGIN/AUTHENTICATE command is needed. Because PREAUTH moves the connection directly to the authenticated state.
statements.trigger: PREAUTH greeting received at connection startup
actions: connection transitions to Authenticated state without LOGIN or AUTHENTICATE

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients that require mandatory TLS MUST close the connection after receiving the PREAUTH response on a non-protected port.
statements.trigger: PREAUTH received on non-protected port with mandatory TLS required
statements.pre_cond: connection.state = Authenticated & connection.tls_protected = false & client.mandatory_tls = true

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Because PREAUTH moves the connection directly to the authenticated state, it effectively prevents the client from using the STARTTLS command.
